summary: Tested the Overview launcher redesign end to end (backend + UI). Backend: 8 of 9 tests pass. Super admin and office admin get the stats; staff gets 403 and anonymous users get 401/403. pending_tasks equals the inbox sum and the inbox now has pending_approvals. FAILED: the inbox (follow-ups due) is not scoped to the office admin's office. UI for super admin works: greeting and tagline, 4 stat cards (2 / 2 / ₹70K / 1) each linking to the right page, featured Dashboard tile at 702px (twice the 343px tiles) opening /dashboard with dashboard-page, '/' focuses search, Esc clears, the clear button works, nonsense input shows the empty state, section tiles show '4 pages' / '2 pages' and open /section/accounts|office|details, /section/bogus redirects to /, the sidebar label opens /section/office and the caret only toggles (checked in the mobile drawer and in the expanded desktop rail). Office admin sees the launcher with 12 flat tiles. Staff at '/' sees StaffDashboard. Mobile 390px: stats 2x2, grid 2 columns, featured tile full width, no horizontal overflow. Dark mode is readable. FAILED: search 'atten' + Enter opens /section/office instead of /attendance.

critical.issue: followups_due counts every tenant lead with an overdue next_follow_up, whatever the office. Reproduced: super admin created a TEST_ lead with office=null and an overdue follow-up. The office admin (KM_BLR) cannot see it in /api/leads (total_leads=0), but their inbox gave followups_due=1, pending_tasks=1 and the CRM tile showed '1 due'. Staff inbox is also unscoped. new_applications is also not scoped to the office for office_admin. Fix: apply leads._scope_filter(user) to the follow-ups query, and _office_visibility_clause to PENDING_APP_FILTER for office_admin.

minor.issue: Returns 422 because year is an int. The frontend interceptor leaves out 'all', so this does not affect the UI. Noted only.

ui_bugs.issue: Typing 'atten' returns [hub-tile-launch-office, hub-tile-nav-attendance]: the Office section's blurb 'Your offices, people, leads, attendance and approvals' matches first, so Enter goes to /section/office instead of /attendance (fails the spec). Fix: rank label matches before blurb matches, or put a section's child pages ahead of the section tile.

Child pages are searched only on i.blurb, but section pages have no blurb property (HubTile falls back to ITEM_BLURBS). So 'payroll' finds nothing even though the Attendance tile shows 'Attendance & payroll'. Use `i.blurb || ITEM_BLURBS[i.to]` in the filter.

integration_issues.issue: Because the inbox is not scoped (see backend), the office admin sees '1 due' on the CRM tile and pending tasks=1 when they have 0 leads.

issues: When a section has an alert (e.g. Office '1 to do'), the 'N pages' chip is replaced, so the Office tile never shows '7 pages'. Consider showing both.
The search placeholder 'Search pages… (press / to focus)' is cut off ('to focu') because of the fixed pr-24 even when the input is empty. The '/' hint also makes no sense on touch devices.

action_items: Scope /api/dashboard/inbox followups_due (leads _scope_filter) and new_applications (office visibility) for office_admin and staff, so overview pending_tasks and the tile badges are office-scoped
Fix Overview search ordering so 'atten' + Enter opens /attendance (rank label matches above blurb matches, or child pages before section tiles)
Search should use ITEM_BLURBS as the fallback blurb for section child pages
Optional: keep the 'N pages' chip visible alongside alerts; fix the truncated mobile search placeholder
critical_code_review_comments: dashboard.py inbox(): the follow-ups query has no role or office scope, and the docstring wrongly says only applications are admin-only

overview_stats collections_month is filtered by user_id == current user (same rule as /transactions). This is fine for single-ledger tenants, but the office admin's own ledger is not office-wide; check this is intended

AppShell.jsx is ~797 lines (more than 700): consider moving the nav config (ALL_NAV, GROUP_ROUTES, ITEM_BLURBS, launcherItems, sectionItems) into its own lib module. Overview and SectionHub import from a page component, which creates a circular-ish dependency
useTileAlerts polls /dashboard/inbox every 60s on each mount; Overview and SectionHub each create their own interval (acceptable)

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (all flows pass except search Enter ordering)

test_credentials: admin and office credentials work. TEST_att_staff_1@educonnect.app is SOFT-DELETED (deleted_at set; login returns 'This account has been removed'), and the tenant is at its Trial seat limit (5/5), so a new TEST staff could not be created. For read-only staff checks I signed a JWT with the backend's auth_lib.create_access_token for the existing staff user blaise@educonnect.app (kept at /tmp/staff_tok) and only did GET requests and page views. Main agent: please restore a working staff test account and update /app/memory/test_credentials.md.
seed_data_creation: Created 2 TEST_ leads (TEST_ovw_overdue, TEST_ovw_scope) with overdue follow-ups. Both were deleted by id afterwards; super admin total_leads is back to 1 and pending_tasks to 0.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run pytest /app/backend/tests/test_overview_stats.py. test_office_pending_tasks_scoped should pass after the inbox scoping fix. The staff fixture uses /tmp/staff_tok if present. On mobile, a 'Set a 4-digit PIN' dialog appears after login; click 'Skip for now'. The desktop sidebar is a rail: click rail-menu-btn to see nav-group-* buttons. Office admin /dashboard renders OfficeDashboard (no dashboard-page testid). Theme toggle: profile-menu-btn → profile-theme-toggle.
rca of the issue: Office-scoping bug: overview_stats scopes total_leads and admissions by office, but pending_tasks reuses inbox(), which counts db.leads without _scope_filter and students without office visibility. Search bug: shown = searchable.filter(label+blurb includes term). Section tiles come before their child pages in searchable, and the Office blurb contains 'attendance', so shown[0] is the Office section.
